lines.en: It's good. I've lived in the dorm since last April.

lines.beaver: 보통 몇 시부터 몇 시까지 방에 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Usually, from what time to what time are you in your room?
lines.beaver_roman: botong myeot sibuteo myeot sikkaji bange isseoyo?
lines.learner: 저녁 여섯 시부터 아침 아홉 시까지 있어요.
lines.en: I'm there from 6 p.m. to 9 a.m.
lines.roman: jeonyeok yeoseot sibuteo achim ahop sikkaji isseoyo.

lines.en: On Sundays, I'm in my room from morning to evening.

lines.beaver_en: Is there anything inconvenient about your room?
lines.en: It's fine. The window is big, so it's bright.

lines.beaver_en: What floor is your room on?
lines.en: It's on the ninth floor of this building.

lines.beaver: 오늘 비가 올 것 같아요. 창문 꼭 닫으세요.
lines.beaver_en: It looks like it'll rain today. Be sure to close the window.
lines.beaver_roman: oneul biga ol geot gatayo. changmun kkok dadeuseyo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll close both the window and the door.

lines.beaver: 부엌은 아침 일곱 시부터 밤 열 시까지 쓸 수 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: You can use the kitchen from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
lines.beaver_roman: bueokeun achim ilgop sibuteo bam yeol sikkaji sseul su isseoyo.
lines.learner: 저는 저녁 여섯 시부터 일곱 시까지 부엌을 써요.
lines.en: I use the kitchen from 6 to 7 p.m.
lines.roman: jeoneun jeonyeok yeoseot sibuteo ilgop sikkaji bueokeul sseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Compared to an apartment, how is the dorm?
lines.en: Apartments are expensive. The dorm is better.
Oh, the kitchen door is broken.

lines.beaver_en: I see. I'll fix it on Monday. Thanks.
